volt1geur.text: Volt1geur fights at the very top of the tracked population, with a matchup rating and resistance both among the very best. The pace is measured rather than frantic, and the headshot share is thin, yet the matchup kill-death line stays near the top. The lifetime board undersells the whole picture, painting a far lower IvI than the matchups support.

valrynnc.text: ValrynNC brings volume and venom: the lifetime kill-death line sits in the highest tier, and the matchups back it up. The trigger keeps a good clip, the edge stays strong while the opposition gets tougher, and the kept share holds firm against the strongest third. A strong regular with a ledger to match.

verylowskillsandveryfewkills.text: VeryLowSkillsandVeryFewKills has been at this since 2012, and the card reads like a long apprenticeship paid off: matchup rating and bravery up near the very top, resistance higher still, plus a matchup kill-death mark to match. Pace sits comfortably in the top ranks, the aim is precise, as the lifetime board puts them a little below the matchups. The one soft note is headshot share, merely middling, but the results speak for themselves.

vsaier.text: VSaier plays a precise, high-tempo game: the rating is top-rank, and so are activity, bravery, and resistance, with pace to match. The aim sits in the top ranks, though the headshot share runs mid-pack, and the lifetime ledger marks them a notch below the matchups. The strongest third drops the game below the pack — the soft seam in a strong card.

vocaloidia.text: VocaloidIA has been at this since 2015, and the craft is plain: the matchup kill-death mark sits in the upper tier, and so do rating, tempo, bravery, and resistance. Accuracy sits top-shelf, the headshot share above average, and the lifetime IvI sits in the upper tier too. Consistency alone sits middling on a long, distinguished card.
